Animal Behavior Chip.name: Animal Behavior Chip
Animal Behavior Chip.description: Chipware. Each chip is imprinted with a single animal psyche. Provides a +4 to Acting checks to impersonate animal's behavior.

Appetite Controller.name: Appetite Controller
Appetite Controller.description:
Suppresses hunger response. User ignores Humanity Loss penalties from starvation trauma but User can still starve. Roll a Death Save at start of 7th consecutive day without eating. +1 to successive Death Saves each day afterwards.

Requires Biomonitor.

Blitzkrieg Arc-Thrower Cyberarm.name: Blitzkrieg Arc-Thrower Cyberarm
Blitzkrieg Arc-Thrower Cyberarm.description:
An "arm" in name only, the Arc-Thrower is a massive electricity cannon. 0 option slots.

The Arc-Thrower is One-Handed Exotic Poor Quality Shotgun that uses Heavy Weapons Skill. Fires "Shotgun Shell" electricity blast with 4d6 damage. Critical Injuries are not possible. Armor is not ablated. If target goes under 1HP from the blast, target has 1HP and is Unconscious.

Firing the Arc-Thrower consumes a charge from the included Radline MagnaSlot BatteryBrick (100eb). BatteryBrick has a 32 shot capacity and can be recharged in 1 hour. Use an Action to swap in a fresh battery pack even if user has no free hands available. Arc-Thrower does not have a hand attachment.

Bodyweight AutoInjector.name: Bodyweight AutoInjector
Bodyweight AutoInjector.description:
Internal Body Cyberware.

Use an Action to load one dose of Street Drug into a subdermal storage pod. Optionally, one can configure a Biomonitor to automatically dose the user upon entering combat, suffering a critical injury, or reaching a predetermined Wound State threshold.

Bug Eye.name: Bug Eye
Bug Eye.description: Large insectoid Cybereye packed with option slots. Borgware.

ChainRipp.name: ChainRipp
ChainRipp.description:
A popout Cyberarm chainsaw with integreated exhaust port. Can be deployed and retracted without an Action. User can not use the hand on the ChainRipp's Cyberarm when blade is drawn.

When deployed, ChainRipp can be revved as an Action and qualifies as an Excellent Quality One-Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon. ChainRipp remains revved until deactivated as an Action.

In the deployed but un-revved state, the ChainRipp is a One-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon.

Chipware Compartment.name: Chipware Compartment
Chipware Compartment.description: Lets you conceal up to four pieces of chipware, no Check required.

Combat Tail.name: Combat Tail
Combat Tail.description: Implanted Heavy Melee Weapon. Requires Neural Link.

Cyberliver.name: Cyberliver
Cyberliver.description: A liver enhancement to mitigate alcohol side effects.

Cyberpillow.name: Cyberpillow
Cyberpillow.description: A comfortable Cyberarm popout pillow for naps on the go.

Cyberskull.name: Cyberskull
Cyberskull.description: User's head is now no longer a 2x weak point. Additionally, user is immune to the Cracked Skull and Broken Jaw critical injuries, both in effect and extra damage. See more info on pg.105 of Interface RED Volume 3.

DeathTrance.name: DeathTrance
DeathTrance.description:
Activate as an action to impede signs of life such as heart rate and breathing. To the casual observer, the user appears to be dead. -4 to all Actions in this lethargic state. Can be disabled with an Action. User may experience bluish or pale skin from multiple uses.

DV17 Medical Tech or DV21 (Criminology, Deduction, Perception) Check to discover user is not actually dead.

Dragoon Plating.name: Dragoon Plating
Dragoon Plating.description:
Requires BODY 16 or higher unless using a Full Body Conversion. Borgware. External Body Cyberware*. Head and Body Armor SP15 and recovers 1SP/day.

Comes with one set of detatchable Dragoon Armor Plates, additonal plates sold seperately.

Dragoon Plating (Metalgear).name: Dragoon Plating (Metalgear)
Dragoon Plating (Metalgear).description:
Requires BODY 16 or higher unless using a Full Body Conversion. Borgware. External Body Cyberware*. Head and Body Armor SP18 and recovers 1SP/day.

Comes with one set of detatchable Dragoon Armor Plates, additonal plates sold seperately.

Drone Remote.name: Drone Remote
Drone Remote.description:
Allows you to control a drone with your mind instead of your agent.

Increases maximum broadcast range to 20m/yds.

EBM PiR2.name: EBM PiR2
EBM PiR2.description:
Built in agent. Audio only but can be linked with other cybergear.

Excellent Quality Internal Agent

  • Remote Hacking DV 24 / Physical Hacking DV 21

External Vidscreen.name: External Vidscreen
External Vidscreen.description: Implanted flexible video screen. Use a socketed Memory Chip or linked Agent to stream video to Vidscreen.

Extreme Biosculpting.name: Extreme Biosculpting
Extreme Biosculpting.description:
A physical conversion to a chosen animal type of human size. Few are willing to carry out the surgery.

Procedure requires a DV21 Surgery Check and materials are 1,000eb

Firebreather.name: Firebreather
Firebreather.description: Implanted Exotic Shotgun. Can only hold one incendiary shotgun shell.

FleshWeave.name: FleshWeave
FleshWeave.description:
External Body Cyberware*. 7 SP for head and body.
Skinweave armor with advanced self-healing functionality. Billions of nanobots repair all damage to FleshWeave(body and head) armor after 10 minutes of rest. Armor does not stack.

* Cyberware Armor does not function as armor in the system, please add the "Sycust FleshWeave (Armor)" item to the character/mook to track

Gang Jazzler.name: Gang Jazzler
Gang Jazzler.description:
Use a Choke Action to stab a grappled target with a popout electrified needle. The target takes no damage but must make a DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs Check. On failed check, target falls Unconscious for 1 minute.

Powered by a rechargeable battery pack (50eb). Battery pack must be recharged for 1 hour after each use. No check is necessary to conceal Gang Jazzler and battery pack. Can be installed in meat arm if it's the only piece of cyberware in that arm.

Gas Jet.name: Gas Jet
Gas Jet.description:
Cyberarm Option. Takes 2 option slots.

Gas Jet sprays a burst of 3 doses of a Street Drug or 3 Vials of Poison/Biotoxin into a 3x3 square directly in front of the shooter (similar to Shotgun Shell attack). Can be used one-handed and is virtually undetectable even without a Conceal check.

All susceptible targets in range suffer the effects of the drug or poison. Targets equipped with gear that neutralizes gas attacks (Nasal Filters & Anti-Smog Breathing Mask) are not affected. Gas Jet must be loaded with 3 more doses after each shot before firing again.

Heavy Subdermal Plating.name: Heavy Subdermal Plating
Heavy Subdermal Plating.description:
External Body Borgware requires BODY 10 or FBC. Protects user's head & body with integrated SP13 armor.

Add @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_armor.Item.kEMGWjMaYcA4rGyJ]{Heavy Subdermal Plating} to track SP

Hello Cutie Mono-Paw.name: Hello Cutie Mono-Paw
Hello Cutie Mono-Paw.description: Cyberarm Option. A concealable Excellent Quality Medium Melee Weapon that deals 1d6 damage and ignores armor lower than SP11.

Hello Cutie Sparkle-Ize.name: Hello Cutie Sparkle-Ize
Hello Cutie Sparkle-Ize.description:
Must be Paired: Create a powerful beam of light up to 25m/yd that illuminates your surroundings.

Use an action to force a target to make a DV15 Resist/Torture Drugs Check or suffer @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_critical-injuries-head.Item.qoegLCfpEOQifeZq]{Damaged Eye} critical injury.

Holo Projector Palm.name: Holo Projector Palm
Holo Projector Palm.description: Projects a small hologram from the User's palm. User can interact with hologram to control a linked Agent's functions. Can be installed in meat arm if it's the only piece of cyberware in that arm.

Implanted Linear Frame Ω (Omega).name: Implanted Linear Frame Ω (Omega)
Implanted Linear Frame Ω (Omega).description: Increases your BODY stat to 16 (adjusting your HP and Wound Threshold and Death Save). Counts as two installations for the purposes of Maximum HL.

Integrated Cyberscanner.name: Integrated Cyberscanner
Integrated Cyberscanner.description: Can scan an individual within 2m/yds and provide a list of all installed Cyberware, takes 1 minute. Spits out an error if a Hardened, Tech Upgraded, or Unique piece of Cyberware is detected.

Kill Display.name: Kill Display
Kill Display.description:
Subdermal Alphanumeric display that shines clearly through the skin. Use a linked Agent to customize the output. Commonly used as "kill counter."
Qualifies as a Light Tattoo. +2 Wardrobe and Style when the user has 3 or more Light Tattoos.

Lead's Turn-On-Show-Off Nails.name: Lead's Turn-On-Show-Off Nails
Lead's Turn-On-Show-Off Nails.description:
Customizable illuminated nail for each fingertip. Includes pen tools for creating custom patterns. Nail patterns can be downloaded from the CitiNet and synced with a linked Agent.
Qualifies as a Light Tattoo. +2 Wardrobe and Style when the user has 3 or more Light Tattoos.

Mediaware BrainGen.name: Mediaware BrainGen
Mediaware BrainGen.description:
Built in agent. Audio only but can be linked with other cybergear.

Poor Quality Internal Agent

  • Remote Hacking DV 17 / Physical Hacking DV 15

MicroWaldo.name: MicroWaldo
MicroWaldo.description:
A wrist-mounted collection of instruments and probes to facilitate surgery.
+1 to Medtech Surgery Checks.

Takes up 1 Cyberarm Option slot and 1 Neural Link Option slot.

MIRD113 Gun Hand.name: MIRD113 Gun Hand
MIRD113 Gun Hand.description: A hand replacement with each finger housing a concealed gun barrel. An Exotic weapon but able to use non-basic ammo.

MonoVision.name: MonoVision
MonoVision.description:
Single-optic Cybereye visor that takes the place of two meat eyes. Too large for a MultiOptic Mount.

Cybereye Options are always "paired" even if there is only one of each type. Penalties from Lost Eye Critical Injury are doubled if the target solely relies on the Monovision for sight.

Borgware.

Mood Eye.name: Mood Eye
Mood Eye.description:
Color-shifting eye lenses. Color is dependent on Neural Link "mood" scans. DV 21 Acting check to fake a mood scan and change color accordingly. Lenses can be deactivated without an action.

  • Red: Rage
  • Blue: Sorrow
  • Yellow: Terror
  • Pink: Horny
  • Green: Envy
  • Gray: Flatlined

Fashionware. Requires Neural Link.

NeuTongue.name: NeuTongue
NeuTongue.description:
Simulates flavor sensations. Use a linked Agent to customize flavor profiles. Can be deactivated without an Action. No sense of taste when deactivated.

Replaces Meat tongue.

OptiShield.name: OptiShield
OptiShield.description: Embedded retractable Mirrorshades. When activated as an Action, user is immune to negative effects of bright light, such as from flashbangs.

PerfectFit Cyberfoot.name: PerfectFit Cyberfoot
PerfectFit Cyberfoot.description:
Adjust foot size to perfectly fit any footwear. User can ignore penalties for wearing footwear that would otherwise be uncomfortable or impracticable.
Can be installed in meat leg if it's the only piece of cyberware in that leg.

Personalized Faceplate.name: Personalized Faceplate
Personalized Faceplate.description:
A personalized faceplate made of durable polymer.

Compatible with your Cyberskull.

PersonalPak KibbleWarmer.name: PersonalPak KibbleWarmer
PersonalPak KibbleWarmer.description: Internal compartment with a high-powered heating element, ideal for warming up pre-packaged meals.

Poser Chip.name: Poser Chip
Poser Chip.description:
Chipware. Allows User to effortlessly mimic speech patterns and mannerisms of a pre-programmed personality. Standard-issue Cyberware for Poser Gangs.

  • +4 to Acting Checks when imitating that specific personality.
  • +5 to Acting Checks with convincing Roleplay.

Poser Chips programmed with countless hours of celebrity footage cost 500eb. More personalized Poser Chips programmed with 10+ hours of footage of a private individual cost 1000eb.

Prehensile Cyberfoot.name: Prehensile Cyberfoot
Prehensile Cyberfoot.description:
Transform a Cyberleg into a Cyberarm as an action.

-4 MOVE penalty while transformed unless in Zero-G. Cannot install cyberarm upgrades.

Professional Cyberhand.name: Professional Cyberhand
Professional Cyberhand.description: A cyberhand capable of wireless interface and up to 50% typing speed increase.

Pursuit Security Inc. Personal Shredder.name: Pursuit Security Inc. Personal Shredder
Pursuit Security Inc. Personal Shredder.description: Heavy duty paper shredder, can be concealed. Features an internal storage for paper shreds.

Raven Microcybernetics Drake.name: Raven Microcybernetics Drake
Raven Microcybernetics Drake.description:
Built in agent. Audio only but can be linked with other cybergear.

Standard Quality Internal Agent

  • Remote Hacking DV 21 / Physical Hacking DV 17

Realskinn™ Faceplate.name: Realskinn™ Faceplate
Realskinn™ Faceplate.description:
A Realskin™ faceplate that looks just like you!

Compatible with your Cyberskull.

Romanova Cyberlegs.name: Romanova Cyberlegs
Romanova Cyberlegs.description:
High fashion Cyberlegs with integrated Talon Foot blades in each heel. Blades can not be removed.

Paired Cyberlegs, 1000eb for both legs. Each leg has 3 slots for Cyberleg or Cyberlimb Options. Roll Humanity Loss once for the pair of legs. Each leg can suffer separate Critical Injuries and must be repaired individually.

Signal Jammer.name: Signal Jammer
Signal Jammer.description: Produces a jammer field over 6m/yd by 6m/yd (3x3 squares). Any wireless transmission attempt must succeed at a DV13 Electronics/Security Tech Check Action.

Smart Lens.name: Smart Lens
Smart Lens.description: Gives a user a single Cybereye Option. Can use one Smart Lens per eye.

Sponsored Covering (Cyberarm).name: Sponsored Covering (Cyberarm)
Sponsored Covering (Cyberarm).description:
Earn 20eb monthly by sporting a light-up advertisement on your Cyberarm. User may be responsible for paying the installation fee. Corporate sponsorship may be revoked if the terms are violated, such as obscuring the advertisement with clothing or engaging in "off-brand" activities.

Can not be installed in Meat arm.

Sponsored Covering (Cyberleg).name: Sponsored Covering (Cyberleg)
Sponsored Covering (Cyberleg).description:
Earn 20eb monthly by sporting a light-up advertisement on your Cyberleg. User may be responsible for paying the installation fee. Corporate sponsorship may be revoked if the terms are violated, such as obscuring the advertisement with clothing or engaging in "off-brand" activities.

Can not be installed in Meat leg.

Superchrome® Faceplate.name: Superchrome® Faceplate
Superchrome® Faceplate.description:
A personalized faceplate made of Superchrome® alloys.

Compatible with your Cyberskull.

Translation Chip.name: Translation Chip
Translation Chip.description:
Chipware, Requires Chyron: Provides subtitles for both spoken and written language in real time.

Does not allow the user to speak any new languages.

VIC Jammer.name: VIC Jammer
VIC Jammer.description: An eye jammer that scrambles digital optics.

Watch-Man.name: Watch-Man
Watch-Man.description: Internal Agent with retractable screen on the user's forearm. Requires a Cyberarm.

Xtra-Dex Smart Glove.name: Xtra-Dex Smart Glove
Xtra-Dex Smart Glove.description:
A Smart Glove with Cyberfinger support. Has 2 Option Slots for Cyberarm Options and is treated as a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.black-chrome_cyberware.Item.f9u0uhwRBcunP0gz]{Modular Finger Cyberhand} for the sake of installing the 5 supported Cyberfingers*.

Requires Interface Plugs to access Cyberarm/Cyberfinger Options installed in the glove.

*Modular Finger Cyberhand must be added after Installation.

Zero Gravity Thrusters.name: Zero Gravity Thrusters
Zero Gravity Thrusters.description:
Negates all penalties related to movement in Zero Gravity. Runs off @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-dlc.dlc_gear.Item.bktOKB09aEQNj9cP]{fuel tanks} that cost 100eb, must be replaced after 24 hours of use.

Requires 2 Cyberlegs, and must be paired.
